scope: MLB regular-season games attended; professional milestones only
verification_policy: Only confirmed career or team firsts and numerical career landmarks occurring in attended games; no season openers treated as debuts without verification. Priority rule: if an appearance is the player's MLB debut, publish only mlb_debut, never team_debut for that same appearance. Team debut requires a prior MLB appearance for another franchise.
